$comment: Canonical cross-SDK error taxonomy (GitHub issues #94, #99). This file is the single source of truth: sdk-python, sdk-js, sdk-go and sdk-rust must all classify these codes identically, and tests/test_sdk_error_parity.py fails the build if any of them drifts. Adding a code here without teaching every SDK about it is a deliberate, visible failure rather than a silent one.

suffix_rules.$comment: Checked before the exact-code table, so any future quota/capacity code classifies without an SDK release.

fallbacks.$comment: Applied when no suffix rule and no exact code matches.

retryable.$comment: A 5xx whose envelope omits `retryable` must be treated as retryable by every SDK. sdk-rust defaulted this to false until #140.
